_what: Reference skull 20 (Hauskatze_Schaedel_PP_noBG.jpg, CC BY-SA 4.0, Auge=mit): three of its six views -> a visual hull (tools/view_hull.py). Seeds of see-through holes PICKED on the overlay (G4).
length_src: Ramos et al. 2021 (CT, n=37) mean; the reference skull is scaled to it, the case later scales the whole skull

dorsal.keep_holes_why: the openings between each zygomatic arch and the braincase (temporal fossa seen from above): white/shadow seen THROUGH the skull; every other hole is a highlight on bone (filled)
dorsal.close_why: R4c: bright nasal bone at the rostral edge was segmented as background -> fragmented runs at y -44..-30 that faked see-through gaps; a 15 px (~1.1 mm) close merges them

loft_rejected: R4c: the rounded view-loft (loft through silhouette extents, clipped by the hull) made a beehive with curtains; the skull is built from parts (tools/skull_build.py) and the hull only clips and measures
